concerns.text: FR-001 (Download AGP data) and FR-002 (Filter samples) lack a dedicated task that explicitly implements the 'halt if no verified URL' logic described in the Plan. T012a checks for the URL, but T013-T017 (Happy Path) are listed as tasks to be implemented even though the Plan states the project is BLOCKED. There is no single task that covers the 'Blocked' execution path for FR-001/FR-002 as a primary deliverable; instead, the logic is split across T012a, T012c_gen, and conditional comments, leaving the implementer without a clear 'implement the block' task for these specific FRs.

FR-003 (Compute alpha-diversity) is covered by T020a, but T020a is marked as 'FAILED: unspecified' and depends on T016 (cleaned data) which is missing in the blocked state. There is no task explicitly covering the 'Blocked' state for FR-003 (i.e., generating a blocked diversity artifact) that is independent of T016. T020c exists but is listed under 'Blocked State Handling' without a direct [FR-003] tag, creating a traceability gap for the requirement to handle the blocked state for diversity computation.

FR-004 (Spearman correlation) and FR-005 (Benjamini-Hochberg) are covered by T021-T023, but these tasks depend on T020a (diversity results) which is missing in the blocked state. There is no task explicitly covering the 'Blocked' state for FR-004/FR-005 (i.e., generating a blocked correlation artifact) that is independent of the upstream data. T025b exists but is listed under 'Blocked State Handling' without a direct [FR-004] or [FR-005] tag, creating a traceability gap for the requirement to handle the blocked state for correlation analysis.

FR-006 (Visualization) is covered by T027-T028, but these depend on T024 (correlation results) which is missing in the blocked state. There is no task explicitly covering the 'Blocked' state for FR-006 (i.e., generating a blocked visualization artifact) that is independent of the upstream data. T031c exists but is listed under 'Blocked State Handling' without a direct [FR-006] tag, creating a traceability gap for the requirement to handle the blocked state for visualization.

SC-001 (Exclusion rates) requires measuring against the total initial sample size. T017 logs exclusion rates, but it depends on T014 (filtering) which is blocked. There is no task explicitly covering the 'Blocked' state for SC-001 (i.e., reporting 'Unmeasurable' or 'Blocked' status for exclusion rates) that is independent of the upstream data. T017b exists but is listed under 'Blocked State Handling' without a direct [SC-001] tag, creating a traceability gap.

SC-002 (Correlation strength) and SC-003 (FDR control) require measuring against benchmarks. T023 flags correlations, but it depends on T021 (correlation) which is blocked. There is no task explicitly covering the 'Blocked' state for SC-002/SC-003 (i.e., reporting 'Blocked' status for these metrics) that is independent of the upstream data. T025b exists but is listed under 'Blocked State Handling' without a direct [SC-002] or [SC-003] tag, creating a traceability gap.

SC-005 (Reproducibility) requires SHA-256 hash comparison. T035 covers this, but it depends on T016 (cleaned data) and T012a passing. There is no task explicitly covering the 'Blocked' state for SC-005 (i.e., verifying the structure of blocked artifacts instead of data hashes) that is independent of the upstream data. T035 includes a 'Blocked Path' description, but it is not a separate task with a clear [SC-005] tag for the blocked state, creating a traceability gap.

T012a, T012c_gen, T012d, T012d_gen, T016b, T017b, T020c, T025b, T031c are listed as 'Blocked State Handling' tasks but lack consistent [FR-NNN] or [SC-NNN] tags. While their descriptions mention the requirements, the lack of explicit tags makes automated traceability difficult and risks these tasks being overlooked if the 'Blocked' state is not manually checked.

T020a is marked as 'FAILED: unspecified' and has a dependency on T016 which is missing in the blocked state. The task description does not clearly state how to handle the blocked state for alpha-diversity computation, relying instead on T020c which is a separate task. This creates ambiguity for the implementer on whether T020a should be implemented or skipped in the blocked state.

T024 is marked as 'FAILED' due to missing input data. The task description does not clearly state how to handle the blocked state for correlation results, relying instead on T025b which is a separate task. This creates ambiguity for the implementer on whether T024 should be implemented or skipped in the blocked state.
